title: Sources & further reading
body:
Facts in this guide were checked directly against operator and official sources where possible: Hinomaru Bus (the Kurayoshi–Misasa route), Misasa Onsen's official portal, Sanbutsu-ji/Mitokusan, Misasa Town, Tottori Prefecture's official tourism site, Tottori City's tourism site, Kurayoshi tourism, the Sand Museum, San'in Matsushima Yuran, Yakiniku Masashige, and JNTO for entry rules and emergency information.

A few facts remain flagged rather than confirmed: the Kurayoshi–Misasa bus fare (the operator's own fare table is a PDF this pass couldn't read), Menya Hachibee's hours (no qualifying primary source located), and Japan's current US travel-advisory level (travel.state.gov blocked plain fetches in this pass). These are called out inline where they appear.
